snippet.title: Helldivers 2 - Machinery of Oppression | PS5 & PC Games
snippet.description:
https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/helldivers-2/

The Cyborgs have returned! 
The traitorous techno-terrorists – creators of the abominable Automatons – seek to annihilate Freedom by weaponizing the Star of Peace, Super Earth’s sacred symbol of galactic harmony.
Storm the Heart of Tyranny and execute a fully authorised system wipe in the explosive new major update for HELLDIVERS 2 - Machinery of Oppression. 

HELLDIVERS™ 2 is Out Now for PS5® & PC.

#ps5 #ps5games #pcgames #helldivers2 

Rated Mature
